table_title: List the 43 active year-round (permanent) Antarctic research stations per Wikipedia's `Research stations in Antarctica` article — specifically the 'Permanent active stations' table (which includes Antarctic island stations such as King George Island / Laurie Island / Anvers Island / Adelaide Island / Ross Island alongside continental-interior stations; the article's separate 'Subantarctic stations' subsection, 'Summer-only active stations', and 'Inactive stations' tables are NOT in scope). Schema = Station Name PK + Country (operator) + Location + Year Established, with Country following the project's standard semicolon-delimited multi-value form for joint-operator stations (Concordia 'Italy; France') and other cells master-table-verbatim. Set_filter shape: master article enumerates ALL Antarctic-region research stations across 4 partitions (Permanent active + Subantarctic + Summer-only active + Inactive); query filters to the Permanent active subset only via boolean (active=true AND operating_schedule=year-round AND partition='Permanent active stations' [excluding the article's separate Subantarctic subsection]). Sort = Station Name ASC alphabetical (master-table-native).
db_analog: SELECT s.station_name, s.country, s.location, s.year_established FROM antarctic_stations_master s WHERE s.status = 'active' AND s.operating_schedule = 'year-round' AND s.source_partition = 'permanent_active_stations_table' ORDER BY s.station_name ASC
temporal_note:
Wikipedia 'Research stations in Antarctica' master article accessed 2026-05-20 (post-cycle-2 audit re-fetched 2026-05-21). Universe = 43 active year-round (permanent) Antarctic research stations per the master's 'Permanent active stations' table — this table includes BOTH Antarctic island stations (King George Island ×9, Laurie Island, Anvers Island, Adelaide Island, Ross Island ×2, Marambio Island, Barry Island, Greenwich Island, Nelson Island, East Ongul Island, Galindez Island, Inexpressible Island) AND continental-interior stations (Geographical South Pole, Coats Land, Vincennes Bay, Princess Elizabeth Land, Adélie Land, Hope Bay, Schirmacher Oasis, Mac Robertson Land, Davis Sea, Atka Bay, Queen Maud Land, Prydz Bay, Cape Legoupil, Larsemann Hills, Antarctic Ice Sheet, Terra Nova Bay, Dome C). The master article has 4 partitions: 'Permanent active stations' (43 rows, IN scope), 'Subantarctic stations' subsection (9 rows, OUT of scope — subantarctic islands like Macquarie/Crozet/South Georgia/Kerguelen/Marion are explicitly partitioned away from Antarctic stations by the master), 'Summer-only active stations' (45 rows, OUT of scope — seasonal operation), 'Inactive stations' (69 rows, OUT of scope — decommissioned). Set_filter shape: master partition structure provides 4 candidate universes; query filters via boolean conjunction (active=true AND operating_schedule=year-round AND source_partition='Permanent active stations table'). temporal_sensitivity = medium because new permanent stations are commissioned periodically (most recent Qinling 2024, before that Jang Bogo 2014, Halley VI 2013, Bharati 2012); the universe count grows by ~1-2 stations per decade on average. Source priority: all 4 cells per row come from the master's 'Permanent active stations' table columns (Name, Country, Location, Year est.). Year Established stored as integer per master's 'Year est.' column verbatim (no day/month precision in master). Country cells preserve master's visible text verbatim for single-operator rows; the one joint-operator row (Concordia, master visible text 'Italy
France' from {{Flagu|Italy}}
{{Flagu|France}}) is normalized to the project's standard semicolon-delimited multi-value form 'Italy; France' per cycle-2 audit-recommended normalization. Location cells preserve master's text verbatim including compound locations like 'Dome C, Antarctic Plateau' (Concordia) and 'Laurie Island, South Orkney Islands' (Orcadas) and 'Vesleskarvet, Queen Maud Land' (SANAE IV) and 'Larsemann Hills, Prydz Bay' (Zhongshan) and 'Inexpressible Island, Terra Nova Bay' (Qinling).
_extraction_notes:
Set_filter instance — boolean conjunction filter (active=true AND operating_schedule=year-round AND source_partition='Permanent active stations table' [excluding the article's separate Subantarctic subsection]) over master article's 4-partition station universe. PIVOT context: 5th of 13 floor-lift instances toward 102-target after multiple set_filter source-friction attempts (canals duplicate; lighthouses fragmented; IGOs fragmented; UNESCO Danger List 403; glaciers fragmented; volcanic-eruptions VEI≥5 set-filter-vs-comparative ambiguity). Antarctic research stations has the cleanest set_filter shape: Wikipedia's master article literally provides 4 separate partition tables, so the boolean filter operation is source-visible (active vs inactive; year-round vs summer-only; Antarctic-stations partition vs explicitly-partitioned-Subantarctic-stations subsection). Brings `set_filter` from 5/5 (floor met, just-saturated by existing 5 instances: countries_over_50pct_renewable_electricity + countries_that_drive_on_the_left + transboundary_rivers_by_continent_over_100_miles + transboundary_rivers_by_continent_over_1000_km + worlds_reigning_kingdoms) to **6/5** = 5th of 13 floor-lift instances toward 102-target (after epidemics-1M lifting comparative + WWI battles lifting multi_hop + industrial-disasters lifting causal + world-expositions lifting temporal). Science/Polar Research NEW subdomain under Science family per domain_taxonomy.md preferred Family/Subdomain pattern (Science used for astronomy + volcanology + biology + academia precedents). engineered-structures/antarctic-research-stations NEW fine-class within engineered-structures bucket extending fine-classes count (joining bridges, dams, tunnels, skyscrapers, canals, etc.). Schema: 4 cols (Station Name PK + Country categorical + Location categorical + Year Established numeric). Sort: Station Name ASC alphabetical (master-table-native ordering). Per-row source: all 4 cells per row from master's 'Permanent active stations' table — no per-station article look-up needed because the master table is comprehensive enough for the staged 4-col schema. source_count = 1 with manual_wikipedia gt_construction. claim_type = source_defined because the 43-row universe is precisely what the master's 'Permanent active stations' table enumerates — no curator selection, no per-row supplementation, no exhaustive-set claim beyond what the source provides. Universe count = 43 (per master's table row count); precedent special cases: Concordia is joint Italy+France operator (master visible-text renders as 'Italy
France' from {{Flagu|Italy}}
{{Flagu|France}} wikitext; normalized to project's standard semicolon-delimited multi-value form 'Italy; France' per cycle-2 audit recommendation); Eduardo Frei and Villa Las Estrellas is a compound entry in master (single row, two named facilities; preserved verbatim as 'Eduardo Frei and Villa Las Estrellas'); GARS = German Antarctic Receiving Station (preserved as 'GARS' verbatim per master). Year range: 1903 (Orcadas, oldest) to 2024 (Qinling, newest). Country distribution: Argentina 6, Russia 5, Chile 4, United States 3, China 3, Australia 3, India 2, South Korea 2, United Kingdom 2, Germany 2, others (Brazil, Czech Republic, France, 'Italy; France', Japan, New Zealand, Norway, Poland, South Africa, Ukraine, Uruguay) 1 each. Set_filter justification: master article's 4-partition structure (Permanent active stations [43 in scope] / Subantarctic stations subsection [9 out of scope] / Summer-only active stations [45 out of scope] / Inactive stations [69 out of scope]) directly maps to source-visible boolean filter operation — query selects rows where (status='active' AND operating_schedule='year-round' AND source_partition='Permanent active stations table') from the union of all 4 partitions, returning the 43 rows of the Permanent active partition. Note that the in-scope partition contains Antarctic island stations (King George Island, Laurie Island, Anvers Island, Adelaide Island, Ross Island, Marambio Island, etc.) — the cycle-2 audit BLOCKING fix corrected an earlier (incorrect) framing that described the in-scope partition as 'continental-only', which was false for many staged rows.
